40044918.name: Elemental HERO Stratos
manualResponsibilities: Confirm a legal optional Normal/Special Summon trigger window. This effect can miss timing and can activate during the Damage Step; the extension does not adjudicate chains, summon negation, effect negation or changed card names.

Declare search or destruction at activation. Destruction does not target: choose Spells/Traps and count other face-up Elemental, Destiny and Evil HERO monsters only at resolution. Hero Kid is excluded.

Duelingbook permits controllers to move their own field cards. The extension displays selected destruction cards in its panel and moves yours; the opponent must move theirs. It sends no duel chat messages. Apply destruction protection, replacement effects and simultaneous destruction consequences manually. Cancel automation if native To GY movement is inappropriate.

The search requires a legal matching monster in Deck; confirm this without opening the Deck before activating. Continuous search prohibitions are checked face-up; adjudicate negated continuous effects and other restrictions manually.

comparisonSources.note: The April 2010 historical mapping uses Elemental, Destiny and Evil HERO names, not an unrestricted modern HERO family. Destruction choices occur at resolution and may be empty.

09411399.name: Destiny HERO - Malicious

corrections.summary: Prevent activation while a face-up Necrovalley is on either field.
If all monster zones become occupied before resolution, destroy a matching Deck copy and send it to the Graveyard instead of summoning.

manualResponsibilities: Choose a legal ignition-priority window; chains, negation, replacement effects and whether continuous effects are negated are adjudicated manually.
Duelingbook represents destruction with native To GY movement. Apply any consequences of destruction manually.

comparisonSources.note: The currently displayed Edison-specific ruling discusses ignition priority. It does not list the older Necrovalley and full-zone cases; absence alone is not evidence to remove historical behavior.
